run_generate_prompts: run the generate_data module to generate prompts for a given topic and subtask using a language model
construct_prompt_build: construct a prompt for generating additional prompts with a topic, examples list, and subtask
generate_single_prompt_run: generate a single prompt using a language model for a given topic and subtask
review_OBJECT_SUBTASK: review the OBJECT_SUBTASK constant and its usage for generating object-based prompts
review_CONCEPT_SUBTASK: review the CONCEPT_SUBTASK constant and its usage for generating concept-based prompts
